visual.general_description: Twelve-lead electrocardiogram printout of the index patient.
visual.detailed_description: A twelve-lead ECG arranged in three rows and four columns on a plain light background with no visible grid. Small lead labels read I, aVR, V1 and V4 in the top row; II, aVL, V2 and V5 in the middle row; III, aVF, V3 and V6 in the bottom row. Each lead segment contains three to four repeated complexes, with a rectangular calibration-style pulse at the right end of each segment. In the limb leads the complexes are small with an upright QRS in leads I, II, aVL and aVF and a small QRS in lead III; aVR is predominantly downward. In V1 to V3 the QRS complexes are predominantly downward with tall upright deflections in V4 to V6. The baseline between complexes in V1 appears raised relative to other leads. No header text, patient identifiers, rate, interval values or interpretive text are visible.

visual.general_description: Two intraoperative transesophageal echocardiographic long-axis views, grayscale (A) and with color-flow Doppler (B), showing an aneurysm adjacent to the left atrium.
visual.detailed_description: Side-by-side sector-shaped transesophageal echocardiograms with scanner header and footer text. Panel A is grayscale with labels LA, ANEURYSM, MV, AV, LV and A-Ao; panel B is the same view with a multicolored Doppler flow overlay at the left atrium and aneurysm region.

panels.general_description: Grayscale transesophageal echocardiogram long-axis view with labelled LA, MV, AV, LV, A-Ao and an echo-free aneurysm cavity.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A, a sector-shaped grayscale transesophageal echocardiogram on a black background. Printed labels mark LA near the top center, ANEURYSM at the upper right-center, MV, AV, LV at the left and A-Ao at the right. A rounded echo-free (dark) cavity labelled ANEURYSM lies to the right of and adjacent to the LA, bordered by a thin curved wall, and appears to lie behind the A-Ao. The mitral and aortic valve structures are shown between the LV and the A-Ao. Header text in the upper left and right corners and footer scanner text reading Phased, Ro-TEE Array and an IND marker, with a date and time stamp, probe frequency and power text, a depth scale numbered 1 to 6, a gray bar at upper left and a circular probe-orientation icon.

visual.general_description: Short-axis transesophageal echocardiographic view of the aortic valve region with color-flow Doppler and a labelled aneurysm.
visual.detailed_description: A sector-shaped transesophageal echocardiogram with a color-flow Doppler overlay on a black background. Printed labels mark LA at the top center, RA at the left, ANEURYSM at the upper right inside a large region of red flow signal, AV at the right-center and RV at the lower center. The large red color-flow area at the upper right is bordered by blue, yellow and green mosaic colors adjacent to the LA region. A color-velocity bar is at left with the printed number 53.1 twice beside it, and the header reads MaxV. Scanner header and footer text include a date and time stamp, probe frequency and power text, a depth scale numbered 1 to 6, Phased and Ro-TEE Array text and an IND marker. The aortic valve leaflets lie in the middle of the image; calcification and the number of leaflets cannot be judged confidently from this still frame.
